shipReasons: No critical defect. With real keys, all seven listed chapters load and reach a first menu and a targeting step. The engine finishes every listed chapter on 16 seeds, with 6 of 8 intended wins in ch. I. The ch. IV victory and the ch. I defeat both reach results and move on. There were no console errors and no 404s.
No major regression: the only major (R13-04, the Evrae stack covering Tidus) is the same on live.
Every adopted change is present and matches its tile: PR-0002 A, PR-0005 B, pause faces B with Paine A, phone prep A, the s3 plates, and the plates closing at victory.

The combat changes are sourced and their tests pass: FFX-2 magic never rolls (combat-core 2.9), and Mortibsorption runs the threshold counters (ffx-seymour-flux 2.2 and 4.3). The full suite passes (340 files) and tsc is clean.
changedArea is FAIL only for two polish regressions against live (R13-02, R13-03). The rules say polish never holds a build.
